description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource class for managing external asset owner loan product attributes within the Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for creating, retrieving, and updating loan product attributes, utilizing JAX-RS and Swagger annotations, and integrates with the platform's command and read service layers.

classes.name: ExternalAssetOwnerLoanProductAttributesApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource class for managing external asset owner loan product attributes, with endpoints for create, read, and update operations.

methods.name: postExternalAssetOwnerLoanProductAttribute
methods.description: Creates a new external asset owner loan product attribute for the specified loan product ID.

methods.name: getExternalAssetOwnerLoanProductAttributes
methods.description: Retrieves all loan product attributes associated with a specified loan product ID, optionally filtered by attribute key.

methods.name: updateLoanProductAttribute
methods.description: Updates an existing loan product attribute identified by attribute ID and loan product ID.
